verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents a public REST API on developers.heygen.com. The docs cover an API-key quickstart, batch endpoints with webhooks, and typed schemas. Endpoint-level docs cover video creation, Video Agent revisions, account and credit info, and scoped restricted keys. A probe confirmed a live llms.txt, and the API is also exposed via CLI and MCP. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all standard paths returned 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of API usage.
